conviction_note: Zero. The dated event is almost certainly the statutory FY26 Annual Report, which is due by 30 Sep and has not been confirmed for 25 Sep; AT4's two previous annual reports landed on 27 Sep 2024 and 30 Sep 2025, and on the one uncontaminated case the stock moved +2.9%, about two ticks at A$0.065. What cash and runway will show is already disclosed through quarterly 5Bs and the 28 Jul pro-forma. The one real event inside the window is the Del Sol deal's 27 Sep End Date (completion or an extension), and its sign cannot be called.

filer_type_check: quarterly_report_only (12 Appendix 5B quarterlies over 3 years, no 4D/4E). The issuer has a June year-end: it lodges an 'Interim Financial Report' in March, and an 'Annual Report to shareholders' plus the Appendix 4G in the last week of September (27/09/2024 18:45, 30/09/2025 16:50). The baseline classifier counts neither as a print. The 25 Sep vendor date lines up with that statutory annual report, not a 5B; the next 5B (September quarter) is due by 31 Oct, outside the window. So I hunted what the annual report could add to the already-disclosed cash, such as a going-concern emphasis, impairments or post-balance-date events, and whatever else is dated inside the window.
event_check: NOT CONFIRMED FOR THE WINDOW. The ASX 2026 archive (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=AT4&timeframe=Y&year=2026) has no 'Notice of Results', no date notice and no annual report yet; the last lodgement is 'Results of Meeting' on 21/09/2026 18:27. The annual report is a real obligation due by 30 Sep 2026. But prior years were 27/09/2024 (Fri, 18:45) and 30/09/2025 (Tue, 16:50) per https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=AT4&timeframe=Y&year=2025 and ...&year=2024. Any lodgement from 28 Sep after the close through 30 Sep falls outside the close(25 Sep) to close(28 Sep) window. The vendor's 25 Sep date is therefore a plausible guess, not a fact. The event exists, but its date inside the window is unverified.
session_check: amc is plausible but not verified: AT4's two prior annual reports were lodged at 18:45 and 16:50 Sydney, after the close (ASX 2024/2025 archive URLs above). That is baseline plus history, with no forward notice.
positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short 0.0246% (449,190 shares) as of 2026-09-18, unchanged from 2026-09-11, lag 3 sessions. The short book is negligible, with no squeeze fuel and no building shorts. The implied register is about 1.83bn shares (derived from 449,190 / 0.0246%). The tape matters more: run_up_5d +16.1% (0.054 on 18 Sep to 0.068 on 22 Sep, on the 16 Sep refinery restart and 21 Sep ingot news), then fading to 0.065. run_up_20d −13.3%. Price lean +0.68 is essentially all run-up.

outside_window.finding: At Del Sol completion AT4 issues 803,644,969 consideration shares to the Nexus shareholders plus A$10.15M of shares to Del Sol at the lower of A$0.04 and the 20-day VWAP (about 254M at A$0.04). Only 50% of each is under a voluntary escrow of 6 months, or until an earlier capital event. That leaves roughly 529M free-trading new shares, about 29% of the roughly 1.83bn pre-deal register. At A$0.065 that is about A$34M, against median turnover of A$0.77M a day. The Del Sol vendor holds paper struck at A$0.04, about 60% under spot. The End Date for the conditions is 5:00pm WST on 27 Sep 2026 and completion falls 5 business days after they are satisfied, so quotation and any selling are most likely from 29 Sep onward, after this window. Resolution 1/5 numbers are in the NoM header; the escrow and End Date terms are read from a partly garbled text layer.

DOE selected AT4's US subsidiary for award negotiations of up to US$18M (ASCEND-Sb), explicitly 'not a commitment'. A signed award would be a real non-dilutive catalyst, but nothing dates it inside the window, and the 16 Sep update says discussions are 'ongoing'.

searched_and_found_nothing: Forward date notice for the FY26 annual report or Appendix 4G on the ASX 2026 archive: none. The last lodgement is 21/09/2026 Results of Meeting.

Going-concern or funding stress: the 28 Jul release gives A$26.5M pro-forma cash before costs, and no placement or trading halt has followed since 19 May. The June-quarter 5B cash table is image-embedded and unreadable here (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260731/pdf/072957tww497x9.pdf), so the exact 30 Jun figure is unverified.

Reaction to AT4's statutory financial reports (ASX dates, Yahoo closes from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/AT4.AX?range=3y&interval=1d): annual report 30/09/2025 16:50 went 0.175 to 0.180 (+2.9%). The interim of 16/03/2026 17:24 went 0.105 to 0.105 (0%). The interim of 14/03/2025 08:19 went 0.029 to 0.028 (−3.4%). The annual report of 27/09/2024 is confounded by a trading halt and a same-morning acquisition announcement. So these filings barely move the stock.

Del Sol completion versus an End Date extension on 27 Sep: 95% shareholder approval on 21 Sep (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260921/pdf/074bh1tzsz5425.pdf). The remaining conditions are the Del Sol option exercise, regulatory and third-party consents and the escrow deeds (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260916/pdf/0744bty9t3wfpk.pdf). Nothing public says which way it goes. Completion is a mild positive headline and a supply overhang, and an extension is a mild negative, so the sign is uncallable and it is not filed as a finding.

Trade press (Stockhead, Small Caps, mining.com.au, Discovery Alert): only restatements of the 16 Sep restart and the 21 Sep ingot announcements, which the +16% 5-day run already reflects. Nothing about the annual report.
Short register: 0.0246%, flat week on week, with no signal in either direction.
baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts against or adds to the lean: the +0.68 lean is the fading 5-day run-up on ingot news, and the statutory annual report is too low-information to override it in either direction.
